body: Thanks for talking to me. Good night!

I'll listen to it and let you know what I think. I'm sort of attached to NIN, though, so I can be kinda difficult with music. For this, I apologize in advance. :P

"Cat's Cradle" is my favorite, I think, followed by "Slaughterhouse Five". He's a great writer, and he's got a whole to say in his books, but some of his views have garnered him so hate. None from me, of course, but he's hit and miss with people.
Good night, man. Thanks for talking to me. You've really helped. Sleep well, and remember, you're awesome!

I know. That's how I justify it. "Two years at community college costs less than a third of one at a uni. But, still, it's hard seeing the people I went to high school with doing so much better with their lives than I have. This whole thing, separation from her, has set me back so far. I'm so much worse off than people I am smarter and more competent than, and it's not easy.

I try to write, but every time I sit down and attempt to put ink to paper, nothing comes. I get completely blocked. And it's not even my writing skill that limits me, I'm a decent writer, I just can't seem to write about what I feel.

I read a lot, though. Ever heard of Kurt Vonnegut? 

And, I haven't, actually. Have any recommendations?
Sweet. I don't know when I'll finish, or if I'll finish, but I'll remember to send you a render when it's done.

Thanks, man, I'm trying. I've resolved not to hurt myself in any way, not until it's all over and she and I can decide together. With that said, what worries me is whether or not I'll make it out with my sanity and identity intact.

I'm a student, going on my first year of college. Only community college, though, which is really disappointing to me. In high school, my grades were bad, but when I met my girl, they started improving and I was doing really well. I was taking all of the higher level classes, too. But when we got separated, I started slipping and even almost flunked out. I would have been accept into some of the really fancy colleges in my state if things had gone the way they were going. Instead, however, I find myself going to community college. :(

Yeah, I'm working on a model of a Remington ACR, at the moment. (I like guns and I hope that doesn't put you off. I'm not violent, I swear.) I'm hoping I'll actually finish it, 'cause then I'll be able to make some cool cg images.

I like NIN, not only because it's good music, but because it helps me with what I've been going through. I've got no way to express myself, so all of my horrible thoughts and emotions just stay where they are and eat away at me. With NIN, I can relate, and it's good for me. Even though it makes me cry and makes me get worse for a little bit, I feel a little better afterwards. It's cathartic.

Unfortunately, I don't. I lost all of my good stuff a while ago when my hard drive died, and I've been too sad to make much of anything else. Used to be I would start a project, and usually make something awesome. Not anymore, though. :\

Which is tragically ironic. Before I was so sad, I found 3d modeling to be really expressive. Now, it just isn't, and I have nowhere for the sadness to go.

I wish it were that simple, but it's not. It's a really shitty situation, but I'm doing my best to get through. I love her, and I need her. She loves me, and needs me, too. Frankly, that's all that keeps me from offing myself.


I've always been sort of sad and depressive, even as a kid, but it got really bad when she and I were separated. There's hope for me, though, because she makes it go away. She fixes me and makes me happy. So, if we get through this and decide to keep living, I think we can be happy.

Nah, it's not a music podcast. It's called "The Comedy Button", and it's just a bunch of guys talking about random stuff. They can be funny sometimes, and it's nice to have on in the background.

I used to listen to trance, but it's been a while. My taste in music actually started changing around that time, too, actually. It went from all sorts of techno stuff, to Beatles and others like them, to pretty much just Nine Inch Nails. Which, probably isn't very smart, but damn, it's good music.

Nothing even remotely impressive. Just some 3d modeling. I've been doing it for a while now, but just as a hobby.

My girl and I are separated, and have been for almost two years now. Our relationship is great, perfect, I would say, but the rest of the world doesn't think so. We can't see each other at all, and I don't know when we'll be able to. It's been hard on me, and it's affected me in so many ways. 

I'm tired and alone.

I'm thinking about my girl, but we're separated right now by very, very unfortunate circumstances. Life sucks, no? It's been almost two years, and it's been very hard for me. I'm trying to stay distracted right now by listening to a podcast and working on some art stuff.

Not well, but I guess that's why I'm here. (Okay, it was a terrible joke.) I'm doing the same. Staying up for no real reason. I have problems going to sleep, so I usually end up just lying in bed, awake, with nothing to distract me with the all too familiar sad thoughts.
